title: Avro Lancaster DV382
memorial_details:
description: Badge: SQUADRON/ 617 617/ ROYAL AIR FORCE/ APRES MOI LE DELUGE/  

Inscription: THIS IS THE SITE/ WHERE A LANCASTER BOMBER DV382/ 617 DAMBUSTER SQUADRON/ CRASHED ON 13 FEBRUARY 1944/ WITH THE LOSS OF LIFE OF ALL THE CREW./ (Names)/ STRANGER, WHEN PASSING REMEMBER, IF IT WAS NOT/ FOR HEROES LIKE THESE, WE WOULD NOT BE HERE TODAY.
